calibration_status: Calibration status: factor weights and grade bands are STARTING values (model h-1.0), not yet calibrated against historical events; calibration is in progress. Scores are an explainable heuristic, not a forecast.

public_intro.description: Drosjer Quantum continuously scores orbital risk for satellite fleets from public tracking data, breaking every score into six transparent factors with a confidence level you can see.
public_intro.tagline: Continuous orbital risk scoring. Six transparent factors. Confidence on every score. Calibration against historical events in progress.
public_intro.public_data_statement: Scores below are computed from public CelesTrak / Space-Track data on a demonstration sample of public objects. No customer fleet is shown.
public_intro.conditions_note: Risk grades are conditions-dependent: they rise during geomagnetic activity and busier conjunction periods, and the engine re-scores continuously as conditions change. A grade is a live reading of current conditions, not a fixed label — the responsiveness is the point.
